status: declared before any P2 clustering fit; HS labels had been seen in phase 1/2 on this same pilot, so this is a development-set protocol, not a preregistered held-out test

dataset.rows_clustered: all 2,000 rows in fixed order, including rows with missing HS labels
dataset.larger_benchmark: the 59,661-photo cleaned set / 27,348 scored objects are NOT available locally and are NOT used
dataset.held_out: no reserved held-out split exists locally; none is accessed. All results are descriptive development-set results.

evaluation.masks: results/phase2/inputs/evaluation_masks.csv (sha256 d333e523...), nonmissing label per level; identical for every method/encoder
internal_metrics: silhouette, cosine distance, exact on all clustered rows of the representation the method was fit on
evaluation.labels_usage: HS labels are read only by the scoring function after all fits and k-selection are complete. They never enter features, hyperparameters or k selection.

dinov2.status: not available locally; not downloaded without approval; excluded from P2

representations.centered_l2: primary; phase-2 predeclared anchor representation (reused saved array results/phase2/<enc>/representations/centered_l2.npy)
representations.pca50_l2: secondary; reused saved array (non-whitened full-SVD PCA50 then L2)

spectral_knn.note: kNN graph on euclidean distance of unit vectors (rank-equivalent to cosine)

hdbscan.noise_scoring: two variants reported: (a) noise_as_cluster: noise label -1 is its own cluster, all masked rows scored; (b) assigned_only: only non-noise masked rows scored, with coverage reported. (a) is the primary, conservative number.

fixed_k_baseline.reason: phase-2 predeclared anchor (centered_l2, k=10), chosen before phase-2 scores

blind_k.primary_criterion: maximum cosine silhouette over k_grid; for stochastic methods, maximum of the seed-mean silhouette; ties -> smaller k

secondary_criteria.elbow_kmeans: Kneedle-style maximum distance to the chord of normalized (k, seed-mean inertia) over k_grid
secondary_criteria.bic_gmm: minimum seed-mean BIC of the diagonal GMM over k_grid
secondary_criteria.eigengap: largest gap lambda_{k+1}-lambda_k of the symmetric normalized Laplacian of the same symmetrized 15-NN connectivity graph, restricted to k in k_grid

blind_k.after_selection: evaluate the partition(s) at the selected k against HS1/HS2/HS3; report mean and SD over seeds; compare to fixed k=10 and to the post-hoc best-AMI k (labelled as oracle, not blind)

seeds.aggregation: mean and SD across seeds; no best-seed selection

runtime: wall-clock seconds of fit_predict only (time.perf_counter), threadpool_limits(4); silhouette time recorded separately; machine shared with other processes, so times are indicative only
output_dir: reports/week6/experiments/ (runs.csv, scores.csv, cluster_sizes.csv, blind_k_curves.csv, assignments/*.npy, environment.json)
preserve: no file outside reports/week6/ is written

environment.compute: CPU only (12 logical cores, ~15 GB RAM, no CUDA); 4 BLAS threads
